summary: Silicom Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing only that its third quarter 2026 results will be released on October 29, 2026, before market open, with a conference call that same day at 9:00am ET. No special-situation event—no transaction, tender, divestiture, activist, or management change—is disclosed. The exhibit is a routine earnings-timing press release signed by CFO Eran Gilad. No deal terms, advisors, board recommendations, or mechanics apply. For event-driven monitors, the only forward catalyst is the Q3 print and call, which may surface guidance or strategic commentary worth watching.
